scope: Nix-backed proof environment and exact bounded UAP theorem surface

current_state.agda: Agda 2.8.0.2 with standard-library 2.4 installed by the official Agda setup action
current_state.nix: pinned nixpkgs supplies Mercury 22.01.9; the NixOS-maintained installer action installs Nix 2.35.1
current_state.retired_non_nix_layer: removed from the repository CI path; its channel/manifest/driver files are deleted
current_state.package_configuration: no repository-controlled legacy package-management configuration remains
current_state.mercury_contract: the forced canonical theorem now exposes the continuous-left-inverse exact-UAP certificate and finite-Int8 continuity contradiction; Mercury remains discovery/equality-saturation verification only

verification.prior_ab: four retired CI A/B executions repeatedly failed to complete while native shell Agda A/B runs reached green
verification.current_gate: Nix migration must kernel-check the same theorem set and execute the Mercury verifier/e-graph lanes
verification.theorem_boundary: bounded exact UAP derives from a continuous left-inverse witness; orbit-observation separation is derived from that witness; the standalone exact universal certificate exposes that separation explicitly
verification.topology_boundary: the minimal topology uses Data.Empty, Data.Unit, and Data.Product; discrete topology makes continuity automatic; finite-Int8 global inversion still contradicts the infinite Nat orbit
verification.nat_boundary: Nat is retained as the canonical unbounded index/value carrier with standard arithmetic and order properties; no mutually exclusive alternative Nat algebra is introduced.
verification.import_boundary: Data.Nat and Data.Nat.Properties provide the existing order/inequality convenience; no ordered-semiring or Data.List.Sort dependency is part of the canonical proof lineage
verification.egraph_scope: Mercury equality-saturation reads declarations only from TheoremsMonolith.agda; CanonicalLearnerMonolith remains imported canonical component semantics and is never an e-graph source.
verification.mixing_scan_boundary: The theorem monolith composes Hadamard orthogonality, learned sparse-attention mixing, Walsh-Rademacher phase periodicity, endogenous attention mediation, associative prefix scan, target-prefix correctness, and exact finite prefix work.
verification.chad_boundary: No CHAD theorem family is currently imported. Base CHAD and Iterative CHAD are admissible only as theorem-monolith additions; Efficient CHAD is excluded.
verification.theorem_egraph_scope: Mercury semantic extraction and equality saturation consume only TheoremsMonolith.agda; CanonicalLearnerMonolith.agda is kernel-checked only as the canonical imported learner definition.
verification.associative_mix_composition: CanonicalHadamardAttentionRopePrefixCompositionTheorem is a first-class field of the forced combined theorem, connecting Hadamard orthogonality, sparse attention composition, Walsh-Rademacher phase periodicity, endogenous attention mediation, associative recurrent prefix scan, target-prefix correctness, and exact prefix-work equalities.
verification.regret_boundary: No Sion theorem, regret bound, or statistical sample-complexity theorem is included; environment-dependent statistical claims are pruned.
verification.injectivity_boundary: Injectivity surfaces are explicit theorem declarations: left inverse ⇒ observation injective; exact UAP ⇔ left inverse in the discrete setting; canonical Nat-orbit injectivity; finite-feature Nat → Fin obstruction. Orbit-state injectivity is named without implying a ring structure.
verification.import_convenience_boundary: Data.Fin is imported because finite carriers and finite sample indices are theorem semantics. Data.Vec is not imported solely for e-graph search convenience because Mercury consumes theorem declarations, not the imported library namespace.
verification.convexity_boundary: No generic topology×convexity/concavity theorem is retained. The concrete Bellman-Shapley layer remains an explicit monotone-operator/inclusion theorem.
verification.emergent_finite_exact_orbit_uap: CanonicalFiniteExactOrbitUAPCompositionTheorem is the theorem-level composition of AQLoop/prefix semantics, exact UAP, bounded/recurrent exact UAP, injectivity/cardinality, finite-time/sample equalities, exact iterate composition, aperiodicity/cycle exclusion, and state/action visit capacity.
verification.turing_capacity_boundary: No Turing-completeness or compression=prediction theorem is claimed.

decision: Preserve one canonical learner monolith and one theorem monolith; make CanonicalFiniteExactOrbitUAPCompositionTheorem the Mercury forced target; retain Agda --safe as proof authority and Mercury as theorem-source equality-saturation verification only.
